title: Find a Shape · Together
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Find a Shape · Together with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose a simple shape such as a circle or rectangle. The lead points out three separate objects in the room that visibly contain the chosen shape. The group agrees that all three objects show the shape. Play eight turns in total, rotating the lead. The group wins together if at least five turns succeed.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Find a Shape, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The group agrees that all three objects show the shape.
recall.why: The group agrees that all three objects show the shape.
